content.title: About
content.content: Rice, white, with lentils is a ready‑to‑eat product consisting of boiled white rice mixed with cooked lentils. The combination of rice carbohydrates and lentil plant protein makes it a balanced source of energy and nutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The rice‑lentil combination is traditional in Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines.
Lentils are rich in iron, while rice provides a quick source of glucose.
The dish stores well and reheats quickly, making it popular in cafeterias and on‑the‑go meals.
A low‑salt version is suitable for sodium‑restricted diets.

items.title: Balanced source of protein and carbs
items.content: Lentils supply plant protein and rice delivers easily digestible carbohydrates, supporting sustained energy.

items.title: Rich in iron and folate
items.content: Lentils contain iron and folic acid, important for blood formation and nervous‑system health.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The product contains virtually no fat, making it suitable for low‑fat diets.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Lentils add fiber that promotes healthy digestion.

items.title: Supports blood‑sugar control
items.content: The mix of slowly digestible lentil carbs and faster rice carbs helps moderate the glycemic response.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to lentils.

items.title: Presence of antinutrients
items.content: Lentils contain phytic acid, which in large amounts can reduce mineral absorption.

items.title: High glycemic index of white rice
items.content: White rice can raise blood glucose quickly; people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The product can be eaten on its own, added to salads, soups, or used as a side dish for meat and fish. Feel free to season with herbs, spices, or a drizzle of olive oil.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For longer shelf life keep refrigerated, where it stays fresh for up to 7 days.
